reasoning: Both meetings continue the same tapering regime established earlier in 2014, with the April meeting simply executing another $10 billion reduction in monthly asset purchases (MBS from $25B to $20B, Treasuries from $30B to $25B), identical in structure and language to the March reduction. The forward guidance on the federal funds rate, the reaction function, and the overall accommodative stance are unchanged, with near-verbatim policy statement language across both documents.
key_quote: Beginning in May, the Committee will add to its holdings of agency mortgage-backed securities at a pace of $20 billion per month rather than $25 billion per month, and will add to its holdings of longer-term Treasury securities at a pace of $25 billion per month rather than $30 billion per month.
